SysDataModelXML.SQLScript:
DECLARE @CLMCHS VARCHAR(30) = '{0}'; DECLARE @STRDATE DATE='{1}' DECLARE @ENDDATE DATE='{2}' DECLARE @BLNO VARCHAR(30) = '%{3}%'; DECLARE @INVNO VARCHAR(30) = '%{4}%'; DECLARE @CONTNOE VARCHAR(30) = '%{5}%';
SELECT TOP (500) S.[ID] ,S.[DOCNUM] ,S.[DOCLIN] ,S.[ITMNO] ,ITM.ITMNAM+ITM.ITMNAM1+ITM.ITMNAM2 ITMNAM --产品描述 ,S.[ITMVER] ,S.[IVATTYP] ,H.BLNO ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(10),H.ETD, 21) ETD ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(10),H.ETA, 21) ETA ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(10),H.BLD, 21) BLD ,H.INVNO ,P.CONTNOE ,IVATTYP.OPTDES IVATTYPDES ,S.[REQDAT] ,S.[UOM] ,S.[UOMCOE] ,S.[STU] ,S.[QTY] ,S.[QTYSTU] ,S.[PRCQTY] ,S.[PRCQTYSTU] ,S.[PRTQTY] ,S.[PRTQTYSTU] ,S.[NETPRI] ,S.[GROPRI] ,S.[TAXRT] ,S.[NETAMT] ,S.[TAXAMT] ,S.[GRPAMT] ,S.[REMARK] ,S.[LOT] ,S.[SRCTYP] ,S.[SRCDOC] ,S.[SRCLIN] ,dbo.OPTDES('DOCSTA', H.DOCSTA) DOCSTA ,S.[CLOREA] ,S.[CREUSR] ,S.[UPDUSR] ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(16), S.[CRETIM], 21) CRETIM ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(16), S.[UPDTIM], 21) UPDTIM ,IIF(S.DOCSTA='1','','1') LDEBFLG ,IIF(S.DOCSTA IN('1','2'),'','1') LCLBFLG FROM [PBOLD] S LEFT JOIN PBOLH H ON S.DOCNUM=H.DOCNUM LEFT JOIN PORDER P ON S.SRCDOC=P.DOCNUM LEFT JOIN ITM ON ITM.ITMNO=S.ITMNO LEFT JOIN LINKOPT DOCSTA ON DOCSTA.OPTID=H.DOCSTA AND DOCSTA.OPTTYP='DOCSTA' LEFT JOIN LINKOPT IVATTYP ON IVATTYP.OPTID=S.IVATTYP AND IVATTYP.OPTTYP='IVATTYP' WHERE CONVERT(VARCHAR(10),[{0}],21) BETWEEN @STRDATE AND @ENDDATE AND H.BLNO LIKE @BLNO AND H.INVNO LIKE @INVNO AND P.CONTNOE LIKE @CONTNOE ORDER BY S.DOCNUM DESC,S.DOCLIN
